description: Engine-derived case alternatives and playback plan; no measured practice record.

case.algorithm_policy: Original baseline plus up to three sourced alternatives. Alternatives must be within 2 HTM of the shortest available or 1 coded comfort point of the lowest cost. Counts include setup turns and explicit rotations; global optimality unproven.
case.scope: F2L is a curated engine-derived insertion subset, not all conventional F2L cases. OLL: 57; PLL: 21.
